name: dispatch
description: Local-first control plane for AI coding agents with shared files

scripts.finalize:web: pnpm run check:web && pnpm run build:web
scripts.check: node scripts/check-runner-boundary.mjs && pnpm --filter @dispatch/runner-protocol check && pnpm --filter @dispatch/runner-client check && pnpm --filter @dispatch/runner-conformance check && pnpm --filter @dispatch/shared check && pnpm --filter @dispatch/server check && pnpm run check:web && pnpm run check:site && pnpm --filter @dispatch/browser-extension check
scripts.ci: node --test scripts/playwright-policy.test.mjs && pnpm run format && pnpm run check && pnpm run lint:web && pnpm run build && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.test: pnpm run test:runner-boundary && pnpm run test:runner-packages && pnpm run test:local-parity && pnpm --filter @dispatch/server test && pnpm --filter @dispatch/web test && pnpm --filter @dispatch/browser-extension test
scripts.test:runner-packages: pnpm --filter @dispatch/runner-protocol test && pnpm --filter @dispatch/runner-client test && pnpm --filter @dispatch/runner-conformance test
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter @dispatch/server test:unit && pnpm --filter @dispatch/web test && pnpm --filter @dispatch/browser-extension test
